findings_so_far: MARKER ON THE MAP: YES. Through the ordinary save door. saveState() -> set world.discovery.cells to an all-ones raster and world.discovery.places to all 42 poi ids -> loadState(). ZERO dropped by the load audit; the map then draws 42 place squares, 35 of them for places the body never stood in, and the whole province rendered (painted_frac 1.0). map-probe L3 forges only the PLACE LIST and leaves the raster honest, so its corroboration check passes; the raster is in the same blob an attacker controls, so the corroboration is a fixed-point test on its own input. Evidence: reports/runs/CRITIC-W1-21-R1B/critic-w1-21-r1b.json F1/F2/F3, map-forged-save.png.

REGISTER-NOT-PICTURE: getUIState().map.mutator_arities — the exact evidence AMENDMENT-W1-MAP-01 §3b tells a critic to read from the running object — is a hand-written literal {observe, suspend, resume}. The object's prototype carries a FOURTH mutator, restore(blob), arity 1, which names places. The compliance report is built from a list, so it cannot report the one thing it exists to detect. G1/G2.

PAUSED SCREEN STILL DOES NOT REDRAW ON A MODEL CHANGE. W1-MAP fixed the FOCUS half (focusSignature in the build() cache key). Engine._afterStep() applies ui.pending on PAUSED frames, so using an item changes sim.inventory while the frame, the mode, the touch signature and the focus are all unchanged. Measured in PIXELS with a working control: focus move = 55,656 px change; use a black-water draught (model 3 -> 2) = 0 px change; close and reopen the screen = 102 px change. H0/H2/H3.
